newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota unemployment up 0.3 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota unemployment up 0.3 pct in April.

text.p: Minnesota's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose 0.3 percent to 3.4 percent in April as a result of a severe blizzard early in the month and spring flooding, the state Department of Economic Security reported Thursday.

Unemployment was down in April compared to the four percent recorded a year earlier, and the state workforce expanded by an above-normal 3,300 for the month despite the snow and flooding, the department reported.
The U.S. unemployment rate dropped from 5.2 percent in March to 4.9 percent in April, down from 5.5 percent in April 1996.
